title: CS61A homework with student-rated LLM hints
summary: Students repeatedly submit CS1 homework code to an autograder and can request an LLM-generated hint on each submission. They rate hint quality, including whether it is misleading, allowing inaccurate guidance and student reactions to be studied.

sources.title: Spotting AI Missteps: Students Take on LLM Errors in CS1
sources.evidence_quote: Students can request feedback from an LLM-based bot with each submission

assessment.summary: Solve CS61A programming homework with unlimited autograder submissions.
student_actions: Optionally request a bot hint with a submission.
Rate the hint's usefulness or accuracy.

outputs.artifact: Python homework code and hint ratings

student_role.description: An LLM homework tutor generated hints; students could flag misleading or incorrect responses.

grading.method: Autograder accepted unlimited submissions; other grading details were not reported.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: Dataset covered about 100,000 requests over three semesters in a roughly 2,000-student course; 40 flagged sequences were sampled.
